_what: C-9 T10-1b scatter kit: six props from the T10K sheets, built by Tripo H3.1 multiview, reduced to ~8k tris, at true scale. Same shape as barrow_assets.json, plus footprint_radius_m and snow_bed_ok.
_transform: SCALE, YAW AND ORIGIN ARE BAKED INTO THE GLB. height_m is what the model measures and yaw_deg is 0, so a reader that applies this manifest the way barrow_assets.json is applied applies identity. yaw_baked_deg and scale_baked record what was applied.
_origin: base at y = 0, XZ origin at the centre of the footprint AABB.
_yaw_convention: azimuth A places the camera at (sin A, 0, cos A) from the object, up +Y. The painted FRONT view of each prop was turned to azimuth 47, the play camera's, so yaw 0 shows the face the sheet drew. pitch 52.95354.
_snow_bed_ok: base_coverage >= 0.60, where base_coverage is the top-down silhouette area of the bottom 0.10 m of the model over the silhouette area of the whole -- how much of its own footprint the prop fills at ground level. The slab is 0.10 m, an absolute depth rather than a share of the height, because a drift's toe is a physical thing: a share would judge a 0.43 m log against a 0.064 m slab and a 1.6 m spear against a 0.24 m one, and call the log the worse bed.
_pitch_correct: FALSE for every prop in this kit. These sheets were painted from words, not cut from the 52.95-degree concept, so the barrow's 1.660 Y stretch does not apply and is not applied.

rocks.retired_because: the sheet stacked the three rocks into a pile instead of setting them apart, so the cluster is 0.53 m across against a brief of 1.10. Re-issued in T10K-A2 at about 2:1.
rocks.brief: largest ~0.5 m high, cluster ~1.1 m across
rocks._size_m_note: the object's OWN size, measured before the yaw. An AABB is world-axis-aligned, so the turned box below is 2.6 m in neither axis for a 2.6 m log.

stump.retired_because: the sheet drew a tall stump with a tight root ball, so the roots reach 0.53 m against a brief of 1.20, and 40%% of the root fingers were lost in the build. Re-issued in T10K-A2, low and broad.
stump._size_m_note: the object's OWN size, measured before the yaw. An AABB is world-axis-aligned, so the turned box below is 2.6 m in neither axis for a 2.6 m log.

log.scale_note: non-uniform: length 2.603, both transverse axes 1.226, so the trunk (median section over the central 60%, 0.705 of the silhouette height) measures 0.30 m and the section stays circular
